text.text_excerpt: *I had a great tarot reading with Patricia, so this review is only about my experience with this particular reader. My friends were not as happy with their readings.* This tea shop offers palm, tarot and tea leaf readings. The tarot reading are $35 for 10 minutes. There are several readers so there wasn't a wait for me and my 2 friends. You also receive a free cup of tea (I chose mint and it was very refreshing) and a CD recording of your session. I'm kind of a skeptic, but I have to say that I was impressed by Patricia's intuitiveness. She was often spot on with her insights. Overall the experience was great for me. Love this place! I'm a local but brought some friends who were visiting from out of town, & this really was a fun and enlightening experience. This isn't your "run of the mill" supernatural experience. This shop has been family owned since it's opening day in the 1920's, the current owner chooses all of his talented staff very carefully, and you can really feel that they care about you and your time spent in their shop. We did the 10 minute tarot card reading, and I can't wait to go back for a tea reading. OK so I'm going to start off this review by declaring that I'm not a hugely spiritual person. Ghosts are probably real, but I've never sought this type of transaction. I was visiting New Orleans for work (and pleasure) and my boyfriend and I figured that while we're down here, we should do tarot cards or something of that nature. After checking it out on Yelp, decided to do the tea leaf reading, what Bottom of the Cup Tearoom is historically known for. $35 for 10 minutes, which is a lot, but whatever, when in New Orleans.
